Chapter 1217 - 29: Inconceivable Prestige (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1217: Chapter 29: Inconceivable Prestige (Request Subscription)

After refining the giant core pillar.

Lin Yuan felt a slight sense of mastery over the sacred land in his heart again.

Whether it was an ordinary core pillar or a giant core pillar.

They were essentially the key nodes of the sacred land.

Theoretically speaking, refining all such nodes would equate to controlling the entire sacred land.

"The Hei Yu Nest’s core has only sixty-three locations, whereas this sacred land’s core exceeds three hundred, with three giant ones..."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Without a doubt, this newly birthed sacred land is absolutely one of the most top-tier among all the first-class sacred lands controlled by the six ancient countries today.

Among the same tier of sacred lands, there are only six, three of which are controlled by the Da Fu Ancient Country.

"The use of this golden mist is definitely not simple."

Lin Yuan thought of the rare treasures nurtured by this sacred land.

So far, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s research on the golden mist still remains at the stage of slowly absorbing it with the fleshly body physique.

...

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in front of the giant core pillar.

He began to review the brief encounter with the Fu Xu Venerate.

"The Fu Xu Venerate deliberately withdrew, conceding this giant core sacred land, fearing mutual destruction with me, allowing other ancient countries to benefit?"

Lin Yuan understood the Fu Xu Venerate’s intentions very well.

With the core pillars already refined and occupied by the Fu Xu Ancient Country, this giant core pillar wasn’t a necessity.

Even if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country obtained this giant core pillar, in terms of the number of refined core pillars, it still couldn’t compare to the Da Fu Ancient Country.

The Fu Xu Venerate believed the Da Fu Ancient Country still held an absolute advantage, hence there wasn’t a need to go all out against Lin Yuan.

"Just that I and the Fu Xu Venerate..."

Lin Yuan fell into a brief reflection; the strike from the Fu Xu Venerate was entirely blocked by his Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Diagram.

But this doesn’t necessarily mean Lin Yuan is stronger than the Fu Xu Venerate; it merely indicates that in a conventional maneuver, the Fu Xu Venerate couldn’t do anything to Lin Yuan.

"The Fu Xu Venerate should have mastered two thirteenth-level inheritances, quite a terrifying power."

Lin Yuan thought to himself: "I’ve cultivated ’Infinite Void’ and the Divine Skill ’Fierce Sun Opening Heaven’, the fusion of the two also equates to two thirteenth-level inheritance methods."

"Moreover, the Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Dao that I’ve evolved also counts as a thirteenth-level method, even stronger than ordinary thirteenth-level methods, after all, it’s my great Dao perfectly aligned with myself."

Lin Yuan analyzed in his heart.

The cultivation threshold for thirteenth-level inheritance is extremely high, mastering two thirteenth-level inheritances is exceedingly rare.

The ’Infinite Void’ that Lin Yuan cultivates, despite going smoothly, owes to Lin Yuan’s extraordinary intellect; for other powerful beings, just surviving the trials in the jade gourd state would be tough.

Even if they barely get through it, most would linger on the threshold.

In the treasury of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, there’s a thirteenth-level inheritance named ’Fierce Sun Heart’.

To master this inheritance, one of the thresholds is to constantly maintain the Fierce Sun mindset, under this mindset, the cultivator’s rationality is completely replaced by Fierce Sun, simply put, virtually devoid of rationality, impulsive, easy to anger, and so on.

However, once ’Fierce Sun Heart’ is mastered, one’s heart will transform towards the heart of a thirteenth-level time life, even if it’s only a ten-thousandth, a hundred-thousandth of the true thirteenth-level life’s heart power, it’s enough to sweep all Heavenly Venerates.

In terms of combat power augmentation, this kind of inheritance transforming towards thirteenth level absolutely surpasses other thirteenth-level inheritances.

But Lin Yuan holds it in reverence and stays away from it.

This kind of thirteenth-level inheritance, even if Lin Yuan fully meets the requirements, he wouldn’t attempt to cultivate, losing most rationality? The future troubles are too great.

"The gap between me and the Fu Xu Venerate is mainly at the life level, ultimately I am just a Dominator Realm life."

Lin Yuan thought to himself but didn’t really mind.

With his current stage, as long as he crosses into the Chaos Stage, he would directly be perfect in the Chaos Realm, after all, having already evolved the Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Dao.

"My greatest advantage isn’t the universe within, it’s not ’Infinite Void’, nor is it Fierce Sun Opening Heaven, but the road I’ve evolved."

Lin Yuan’s gaze was slightly fervent.

Just the first level of the Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Dao already gives his strength such an increase, what if he cultivates to the second level or even the third level?

Compared to this potential Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Dao, perhaps only cultivating ’Infinite Void’ to level seven can compare.

But ’Infinite Void’ reaching level seven is ultimately just a theory, even the creator had no assurance, Lin Yuan considered himself falling short of a true time life.

Compared with it, the third level of the Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Dao still seems more reliable.

...

Just as Lin Yuan was assessing his own strength.

A commotion directly erupted among the Peak Venerables throughout the sacred land.

Compared to the semi-illusory state core pillars, the aura of the giant core pillar radiates in all directions, utterly impossible to contain.

Even a Heavenly Venerate, with just a little sensation, can feel the majestic aura of the giant core pillar.

Previously, the giant core pillar was occupied by the Da Fu Ancient Country, refined by the Fu Xu Venerate, feeling it wouldn’t make a difference.

But now.

The slight change in the aura emitted by the giant core pillar sparked a thought in the minds of all Peak Venerables—

The giant core pillar has changed owners.

"Wasn’t that giant core pillar refined by the Fu Xu Venerate? How could it change hands?"

"Who exactly is it? Among the remaining five ancient countries’ Peak Venerables deployed this time, is there another powerhouse no weaker than the Fu Xu Venerate?"
